subject: planner: fix the wrong transform in the join reorder (#59773)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. In greedy join reorder, when an equality edge must be reversed to match the chosen join tree order, the code now preserves the original comparison function name (e.g. NullEQ for `<=>`) instead of forcing `EQ`, preventing wrong semantics for NULL-safe joins. Added a regression test for #59643 plus a minor Bazel test sharding adjustment.
